answers.Notorious: We have more value on this Showdown slate than most, so I'm going to lean into a stars-and-scrubs build on both DraftKings and FanDuel. While Josh Allen is my favorite CPT, I don't mind the idea of using a cheaper CPT like Keon Coleman or Colby Parkinson. On FanDuel, Skyler Bell is only $300, which provides massive salary savings at FLEX. If he gets a catch, he will pay off his cheap salary. I'm going to be in the small-field tournament streets tonight.
answers.headChopper: I'm building 20 lineups on each site, and I'll break them into pockets of roughly 5 lineups each. Those pockets will be based on different game scripts. My preferred game scripts, in order, are a Rams onslaught, the Rams passing attack exploding, the Rams scoring primarily through Kyren Williams, Josh Allen taking over, and James Cook III dominating Buffalo's scoring. Matthew Stafford is the one constant on both sites and fits into almost all of these game scripts, so I'll be overweight on him.

questions.prompt: What is the most pivotal correlation (or individual player) when it comes to your portfolio of lineups?

answers.Notorious: Josh Allen - While I don't expect him to sustain this rushing touchdown pace (he already has 7 in the first 4 games), he's one of the most productive fantasy football players in the league. I never shy away from using him at MVP and CPT when he's on a Showdown slate. The fact that he's missing his best wide receiver (DJ Moore) could lead to lower ownership than usual at the multiplier positions.
answers.headChopper: Kyren Williams - I think he'll be a pivotal player for a lot of builds, not just mine. He has dominated the backfield lately and racked up fantasy points, so he will be a popular play. This is sports, and we could certainly get rug-pulled at any point. It wouldn't surprise me to see Blake Corum get more work and Kyren flop, but I'm not playing it that way. I'll have plenty of lineups where I'm betting on Kyren being the focal point of the Rams offense, and I'll have him littered throughout my CPT/MVP and flex spots. His success probably defines an entire game script, whereas his failure defines an entirely different one.
